newsitem.title: USA: Canada LPG market falls again on weak U.S..
newsitem.headline: Canada LPG market falls again on weak U.S..

text.p: Canada liquefied petroleum gases (LPG) fell this week amid a continued drop in Midcontinent values, players said Thursday.
In the east, Sarnia hub spot propane prices fell 4.00 cents to between 42.25 cents and 42.50 cents a gallon.
In the west, Edmonton hub spot propane prices fell 3.50 cents to 38.50/39.00 cents.
The butane markets also fell due to lack of demand following the end of the blending season. --((Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk, 212 859-1631))
